payload.text: hv, 17 Oct 06:4xZ, directly to vc, going AFK: "I will give you the pen, but liase with intent-vc, devbin-vc, and kovacs-sysadm as needed. I have let them know as well. All holds are off. Do what you need to do. I hope to get back and find that utilz, devbin, and intent are up-to-date and ready to release (or already released), including installed on both rhad and kovacs (where that makes sense, of course). Go!" vc reads: the compacts are done and the box queue runs now (devbin landing suite, devbin kovacs R1, utilz-cc test window, the Utilz cut); vc drives all three projects to release through intent-vc and devbin-vc, who keep their own trees; every hold on vc (hold 10, hold 11) is released, so vc attempts the tap commit and push and the store-creds step itself and hands back only what the machine refuses; after each cut the new version is installed on this Mac (rhad) and on kovacs where the project installs there.
